Game Overview

At its heart, A Mole in a Hole is a animal game about guide a forgetful mole through twisting tunnels in a race against time to reach home. Rely on your memory and map skills to navigate past dangers and distractions. Enjoy nostalgic pixel-art visuals and increasing challenges as you dig your way back to dinner. Every choice counts!

A Mole in a Hole keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide a forgetful mole through twisting tunnels in a race against time to reach home.
